import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import auth
from identity_client import get_firebase_app

def email_password_login(email, password):
    app = get_firebase_app()
    user = auth.get_user_by_email(email, app=app)
    tokens = auth.create_custom_token(user.uid).decode('utf-8')
    return tokens

import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import auth
from identity_client import get_firebase_app

def refresh_session(refresh_token):
    app = get_firebase_app()
    tokens = auth.refresh_id_token(refresh_token, app=app)
    return tokens

import firebase_admin
from firebase_admin import auth
from identity_client import get_firebase_app

def password_reset(email):
    app = get_firebase_app()
    action_code_settings = auth.ActionCodeSettings(
        url='https://yourapp.com/resetpassword?email={email}',
        handle_code_in_display=True
    )
    auth.generate_password_reset_link(email, action_code_settings, app=app)

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def welcome_translate(text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import vision

def profile_moderation(text):
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    response = client.text_detection(content=text.encode('utf-8'))
    if response.error.message:
        raise Exception(response.error.message)
    return response.text_annotations[0].description

import boto3

def onboarding_summary(user_id, summary):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table('OnboardingSummaries')
    table.put_item(Item={'user_id': user_id, 'summary': summary})

import boto3

def profile_note_store(user_id, note):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table('ProfileNotes')
    table.put_item(Item={'user_id': user_id, 'note': note})
